scope: Account, profile/statistics, lists, history/continue, subscriptions, notifications, auth, status, settings and usage policy
method: Read current source, registered routes and existing anonymized API fixtures. No account requests or repository writes.
mockup_rules: Use actual plugin fields and actions below. Missing optional data must be omitted or shown with the existing fallback, not invented.
All fixture identities, titles and counts are anonymized synthetic examples; they are not this user's account data.
Statistics is currently a section within Account, not a separately registered screen.
Only display LG/webOS settings on the TV mockup; external Android player selection and YummyTV integration are platform-conditional.
Dates are display values in these screens. No editable date/time fields exist here.

screens.label: Аккаунт / профиль
required_for_function: profile.id: used to request account statistics/lists

category_summaries: Six list definitions: Watching 0, Planned 1, Completed 2, Dropped 3, Favorite 4, Postponed 5
counts derived from anime.user.list.list.id and anime.user.list.is_fav
watch time from matching stats[].list.id and stats[].seconds

actions: Open a category's full account list
Open My Reviews selector, then an anime detail
Manual history synchronization only when automatic progress sync is off
Sign out and replace stale Account activity
Guest sign-in action opens yani_auth with refresh_account_on_authorized:true
states: optional statistics sections absent when arrays are empty
profile load failure with account_load_error/account_retry notice
not_supported_here: Send/read messages (only unread count is displayed)

screens.label: Статистика аккаунта

limits: Up to 12 rows for each non-empty statistics array

actions: Six category summary tiles above statistics can open lists
states: Any missing/empty genre/rating/type group is omitted
Whole extended statistics section is omitted if all groups empty
not_supported_here: Drilldown action on genre/rating/type statistic rows

screens.label: Мои списки
required_for_function: Each row has title, definition or history flag, total and results[]
displayed_fields: Six category rows plus watch-history row
Row title with total if numeric
Up to 10 anime preview cards per row
An extra More card opens full category/history
Poster, title and existing card metadata/progress overlays
actions: Remote numeric keys 1 Watching,2 Planned,3 Completed,4 Dropped,5 Favorite,6 Postponed,0 History
Remote color shortcuts red Watching,green Planned,yellow Favorite,blue History
not_supported_here: Automatic import of native Lampa favorite marks

screens.label: Содержимое категории
required_for_function: items[] or lazy=true plus shared loadItems
actions: Open anime detail (category/favorite changes are made there)
Sort: recent, progress, rating, year, title
Sort selection replaces activity with /sort/{sort} and retains loaded rows
states: API failure builds an empty list and calls error notice

screens.label: Продолжить просмотр
data: Merged device-local playback history and remote GET /video/watch-history
Continue-mode remote range up to 300 records
Shared cached episode ceilings; detail requests can enrich missing card metadata
required_for_function: video_id or normalized episode number as resume target
displayed_fields: Next episode flag for a finished episode with a remaining/unknown ceiling
actions: Resume/open episode options through existing history-card action
states: finished episode advances to next episode without moving backwards on a rewatch
empty or remote history failure notice with local fallback
not_supported_here: Delete one watch record from this screen
A promise that every source can resume exactly (iframe player progress can be limited)

screens.label: История просмотра
displayed_fields: Updated date internally used for most-recent sorting
not_supported_here: Clear remote history from the settings action (settings clear only local cache)

screens.label: Подписки
displayed_fields: Anime cards normalized from response array or anime/items/data/subscriptions envelope
Nested source may be item.anime, item.title_data or item.object
actions: Open anime detail through standard Yummy card handler
not_supported_here: Subscribe/unsubscribe management buttons in this component

screens.label: Уведомления
displayed_fields: Unread count of currently rendered notifications
optional_navigation_fields: anime_id or animeId opens anime detail
Episode notification with click_uri containing /catalog/item/{slug} resolves anime then opens detail
actions: Open notification marks that notification read
Open an anime only when a recognized anime target exists
not_supported_here: Delete individual item button (API helper exists but current screen has no action)
Open comment thread/user profile from a generic notification
Confirmation before delete-all is not currently implemented

screens.label: Вход в YummyAnime
actions: Edit password using masked shared input
Successful sign-in refreshes shared history and can replace stale Account screen
not_supported_here: Own application API-key field (official plugin already supplies public application header)

screens.label: Статус сервисов
required_for_function: Snapshot JSON: periods[period] or legacy flat snapshot

screens.label: Настройки YummyAnime

fields.default: true on Android or webOS, false elsewhere

fields.action: Open official website; shows plugin version

not_supported_here: Android external player controls on LG

screens.label: Условия использования
screens.route: showUsagePolicy() overlay; legacy yani_policy component remains registered
actions: Back closes overlay and restores previous controller

fixture_notes.caution: fixture lists.response is a synthetic category catalogue; actual GET /users/{id}/lists is consumed as anime rows. fixture list_stats uses id/count/time, while current Account renderer expects list.id/seconds. Do not fabricate Account watch-time totals from this mismatched fixture.
object_id alone is not used as anime_id by current notification UI. A comment notification containing a catalogue slug is not an episode notification and is not automatically openable.
Use positions/durations only when supplied; no date-picker or per-item deletion UI is implemented.
